title: PACT: Plan-Action Consistency Training by Preserving Correct Plans and Repairing Actions in GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.22591v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GUI agents can formulate a correct immediate plan in their reasoning yet emit an action that fails to execute it, creating an execution gap. This recurring mismatch undermines reliable task completion, as a single execution error can derail a multi-step workflow. In outcome-supervised reinforcement learning, broadcasting a negative response-level advantage across all generated tokens risks penalizing valid planning together with erroneous execution. To address this credit-assignment conflict, we introduce PACT (Plan-Action Consistency Training), a training framework that combines reference-aligned plan protection and plan-aligned action repair without altering the original scalar action reward. translated_title: PACT：通过保留正确计划与修复动作实现GUI智能体的计划-动作一致性训练
translated_abstract: GUI智能体能够在推理中制定出正确的即时计划，却可能发出无法执行该计划的动作，从而产生“执行鸿沟”。这种反复出现的不匹配会损害可靠的任务完成，因为单个执行错误就可能使多步骤工作流偏离正轨。在以结果监督的强化学习中，将负的响应级优势广播到所有生成的token上，可能会在惩罚错误执行的同时连带上有效的规划。为了解决这一信用分配冲突，我们提出了PACT（计划-动作一致性训练），这是一个将参考对齐的计划保护与计划对齐的动作修复相结合的训练框架，且不改变原有的标量动作奖励。通过利用标注的参考动作来识别执行鸿沟，PACT通过屏蔽计划token跨度上的负策略梯度贡献来保护已验证的计划。在保持生成的推理内容不变作为上下文的前提下，它进而倾向于参考动作（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: PACT是一个针对GUI智能体的训练框架，它在结果监督强化学习中通过屏蔽已验证计划token上的负策略梯度来保护正确的规划，同时在推理上下文不变的情况下向参考动作修复执行行为，从而弥合计划与动作之间的执行鸿沟并解决信用分配冲突。
en_tdlr: PACT is a training framework for GUI agents that preserves correct plans by masking negative policy-gradient contributions over verified plan tokens while repairing actions toward reference actions under unchanged reasoning context, bridging the plan-action execution gap and resolving credit-assignment conflicts in outcome-supervised RL.
